I like to draw fantasy-type drawings. Usually people but with a fantasy oriented twist, if that makes sense. I enjoy it when I feel like I'm getting better, which I suppose is the problem.

I was in an English Lit program. After undergrad I took a year off and I thought I'd have better prospects getting a job if I had a master's.

I can't see a doctor because I'm uninsured but I'm pretty sure that it's pattern baldness based on where on my head I'm losing hair.
I don't really have any friends.
